Package org.opt4j.gatekeeper

Interface GatekeeperModel

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
DjlDominancePredictor
public interface GatekeeperModel extends AutoCloseable
Interface representing the machine learning surrogate model. Implementations (e.g., DJL) must ensure that predictIsDominated(float[], java.util.List<float[]>) is thread-safe so multiple Opt4J evaluation threads can query the model concurrently.

  • Method Details

    • predictIsDominated

      boolean predictIsDominated(float[] newFeatures, List<float[]> archiveFeatures)
      Predicts whether the new individual is dominated by ANY individual in the archive.
      Parameters:
      newFeatures - The feature vector of the new individual.
      archiveFeatures - A list of feature vectors representing the current archive.
      Returns:
      true if the model predicts the new individual is dominated by the archive.

    • train

      void train(List<float[]> combinedFeatures, List<Float> labels)
      Trains the model on a batch of comparisons.
      Parameters:
      combinedFeatures - A list of concatenated feature arrays: [ArchiveFeatures, NewFeatures].
      labels - A list of labels: 1.0f if the archive individual dominates the new one, 0.0f otherwise.
